title: La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.08156v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on pretrained vision-language backbones; both tie policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. It remains unclear how much these generation-oriented choices affect control. In this work, we introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. Following Fast-WAM, La-JEPA learns to predict future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes and on LIBERO-Plus with correct instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competing policies. It runs substantially faster than F

translated_title: La-JEPA：基于潜在世界建模的紧凑机器人策略
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型通过适配预训练的视频生成器构建，而视觉-语言-动作模型则建立在预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络之上；这两类方法都将策略架构和推理成本与为生成而非控制设计的大型Transformer绑定在一起。目前尚不清楚这些面向生成的选择对控制任务有多大影响。在本工作中，我们提出了潜在动作JEPA（La-JEPA），这是一个紧凑的世界-动作模型，其策略Transformer在预训练V-JEPA 2.1编码器的特征空间中从头开始训练。遵循Fast-WAM的方法，La-JEPA在训练时学习联合预测未来特征和动作，而在推理时仅生成动作。在没有具身预训练的策略中，La-JEPA在干净和随机化的RoboTwin 2.0场景以及指令正确的LIBERO-Plus基准上取得了最先进的性能，同时使用的参数远少于最强的竞争策略，并且运行速度显著快于F……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: La-JEPA是一种紧凑的世界-动作模型，它在预训练V-JEPA 2.1编码器的特征空间中从头训练策略Transformer，无需具身预训练即可以更少的参数和更快的推理速度在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Plus基准上取得最先进的机器人控制性能。
en_tdlr: La-JEPA is a compact world-action model that trains its policy transformer from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder, achieving state-of-the-art robot control performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus with far fewer parameters and substantially faster inference.
